PLAN "12-Week Moderate-Intensity General Fitness (Post-MI Safe)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve general fitness, strength, and aerobic capacity safely under 70% HRmax"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation and Technique" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x20 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Cardio + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 1x15m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          cat_cow 1x2m rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 1x2m rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          chest_stretch 1x2m rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
          calf_stretch 1x2m rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
